problem_statement: Media: Hide upgrade nudge for editor and author roles On a WordPress.com site with public visibility (can be seen on https://wordpress.com/settings/general), visiting the https://wordpress.com/media page shows an upgrade nudge at the top right (next to the storage space usage). Examples: As seen on an editor profile on a site: As seen on an author profile on another site: This nudge should be hidden for editor and author roles, as they cannot upgrade a site. Only the admins can.
